## Democrats winning everywhere and on brink of controlling Congress

Since World War II, the House and Senate have flipped from one party to the other in the same midterm just three times: 1946, 1994 and 2006.

Democrats are on the brink of doing it again in 2026.

They are winning virtually everywhere in a truly historic sweep. Democrats won Senate and governor's races in Georgia, Ohio and Texas — the latter two states Trump carried by 11 and 14 percentage points, respectively.
